artifacts.summary: Research on linking Sapience automatic write/retrieval paths to the project id: confirms write-side project-key resolution already exists and must NOT be upgraded to a verified project_cid (conflicts with sf1-engine's cross-harness-agreed Ruling 7 on autonomous writes), confirms the read-side project_cid path is genuinely unbuilt and safe to add, and confirms both named app-side dependencies are unmet today.

next_steps: Run /orchestrate 677 to create an implementation plan that excludes write-side project_cid (per Ruling 7), builds the read-side sapience-retrieve.sh project_cid path against a stub, and updates per-repo-scoping.md per the report's Context Extension Recommendations.

memory_candidates.content: sf1-engine's integration/project-link.md section 10 Ruling 7 forbids any write attaching a VERIFIED project_cid from an autonomous task run unless write_origin resolves to 'typed', gated off until two named leak paths close (dispatched-child subsequent turns; non-typed registration of command expansions/skill text/dispatch files for the ported task-workflow archive). This repo's own linked-repo-write-policy.md Ruling 2 and Cross-Harness Agreement already state the Claude Code side agrees: the existing plain project-KEY field (never project_cid) sits below that gate. brain_server.py's _ingest_kos handler confirms the stakes of crossing it: a verified project_cid write overwrites ko['author'] with the real member's own display name and delivers live (follow:true) with no suggestion-lane gating. Any future Sapience task asking to 'send project_cid' from an automatic/postflight write site must be checked against this ruling before implementation, not just against local per-repo-scoping.md docs.

/v1/search and /v1/recent on the Sapience server (brain_server.py) honor a project_cid query parameter as a strict pre-filter (gated on repo_link.enabled(tok), i.e. the REPO_LINK_FOR flag, and verified via cli_project_scope.gate) -- this is a DIFFERENT parameter from the plain &project= slug that per-repo-scoping.md already documented as silently ignored by /v1/search. Both claims are true simultaneously; they must not be conflated when reading or extending that doc. REPO_LINK_FOR is deployed "" (off) in sapience-app's fly.toml as of this finding, so this path is unexercisable live today and must be tested against a stub.

The installed vendor ~/.sapience/mcp.py's sapience_remember MCP tool accepts an optional 'project' argument, but it is an UNRELATED mechanism to the per-repository link/project_cid feature: it is company-store routing (project_slug()/route_ko() matched against config.json's "routes" map, falling back to COMPANY_PROJECT/SAPIENCE_PROJECT) that picks which TOKEN a write posts to, not a tagged-write or per-repo-scoping mechanism. per-repo-scoping.md's write-tools section did not mention this argument as of this finding, which could read as a false completeness claim.
